name: contracts
description: Checks that keep paired changes honest: API vs client, description vs code, limits vs claims.

rules.rule:
- Paired changes (API ↔ UI ↔ mock/SDK): field names, enums, status codes and error codes match the other side's latest commit; say which commit you checked.
- What the PR description and user-facing text claim matches what the code does (e.g. a note says 'newest shown' while the query keeps the oldest).
- The linked issue's outcomes are delivered; a PR that quietly covers several issues gets an optional 'split it' note.
- Under a LIMIT, the rows that survive are the right ones (ORDER BY direction); lists, groups and facets are bounded.
- Lifecycle edges: expiry fields honoured when read, transitions the server will refuse handled, deleted/detached things in history views.
- Tests pin the risky guard (the check that stops a foreign id) and the error/truncated branches.
